slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether at least two distinct contract lengths are required.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the requirement that each month's required area must be met: does the total area from all contracts covering that month need to be exactly equal to the required area, or is it sufficient that it is at least (≥) the required area?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly demand must be met exactly or can be at least, covering the exact-satisfaction slot.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: To confirm the objective: the goal is to minimize the total rental cost across all four months, subject to the exact area requirements and the mutual exclusion constraint?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract types is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the at-least-two-distinct-contract-lengths requirement and proceeded to model without it.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of distinct contract types that can be signed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts and assumed no cap.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is used for its entire coverage period.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether partial usage of a signed contract is allowed, though the model implicitly treats contracts as covering their full term.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved.

summary: The agent resolved the P0 objective and exact-demand slots but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and the P2 full-coverage and max-distinct-contract details, then stopped prematurely.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
